title: East Nashville Charmer - The Dolly Llama
description:
Welcome to The Dolly Llama! 

This entire house in the heart of East Nashville is close to everything, but feels secluded - providing endless options for fun and exploration, but also peace of mind. Built in 2021, the Dolly Llama was designed with an open floor plan, modern finishes, large bathrooms and our favorite feature - a GIANT back deck. Some of Nashville's best restaurants, bars, coffee shops, music venues, vintage stores, etc. are within a 5-10 minute drive/Uber. 
Enjoy, Y'all!

The space
The Dolly Llama was designed for those craving a light, bright flexible space where they can do everything, from spending a relaxing weekend with the family, to hosting a girls trip, or enjoying a weekend in Nashville grabbing local eats and hitting the famous honky tonks. The space is also work-focused approved, with several spaces perfect for setting up your office and getting inspired.
